meta.method: Expanding-window direct OLS forecasts using publication-lag-adjusted HFCIs and latest revised source histories
meta.initial_training_rule: 60% of aligned observations, bounded between 12 and 60 observations
meta.warning: Pseudo-real-time, not a full vintage backtest: HFCI publication lags are respected, but most source histories are the latest revised vintages.

house_price_growth.label: Forward nominal house-price growth
house_price_growth.transformation: Forward percentage change in the national nominal house-price index

housing_credit_growth.label: Future housing-credit growth
housing_credit_growth.transformation: Future level of annual housing-credit growth

dwelling_approvals_growth.label: Forward dwelling-approvals growth
dwelling_approvals_growth.transformation: Forward percentage change in seasonally adjusted dwelling approvals

new_lending_growth.label: Forward new-lending growth
new_lending_growth.transformation: Forward percentage change in new dwelling loan-commitment value

housing_turnover_change.label: Future change in housing-turnover proxy
